Please do not remove messages from talk pages, including your own. All messages are [[Wookieepedia:Talk page policy|part of the public record]] and must remain visible. If you do not want a message to remain on your talk page, you may archive it on a subpage of this page provided that a link to the archive page is placed at the top of this page. Thank you for your cooperation. {{{1|}}}<!-- Template:Msg-talkarchive --><noinclude>
==Description==
Alternative to {{Tl|Msg-talkr}} for use when a user has removed messages from their own talk page.

==Usage==
Type <code><nowiki>{{subst:Msg-talka|~~~~}}</nowiki></code> to place the above warning on a user's talk page.
